definitions.spec: design/ms7/plan.md §3 X2; design/ms7/feasibility/oos.md §3, §4 item 4; change C55
definitions.week: calendar week from Monday 00:00 UTC: (hours since 1970-01-01 + 72) // 168
definitions.full_week: inside the early window (before 2024-10-01) with at least 150 of its 168 hours holding a user-hour of the five regions
definitions.split: the first 37 full weeks are 'fit', the others 'held_out'; the fit window is [start of the early window, start of the first held-out week)
definitions.user_hours: a4b: distinct hashed IPs per region and calendar hour
definitions.p_o_week: per region and full week: the week's user-hour counts by hw, smoothed by a4b's separable form, mean 1 over the 168 hours (level normalized), rounded to 6 decimals; for ['south_southeast_asia', 'south_america'] the counts summed over the 4 full weeks of pool_window
definitions.single_week: the *_single statistics: p_o_week on the week's own counts for every region (separable(counts[region][week]), not stored)
definitions.pool_window: [start, end) of the 4 consecutive full weeks of the week's split that end at the week, shifted forward at the split's start
definitions.borrower_model: a4c_fit: a4b's early model (p_o user-hours, separable; r_oj conversations, default tier map) on the fit window only
definitions.level: a week's user-hour total over the mean weekly total of the full weeks (not used by p_o_week)
definitions.hw: 24*dayofweek + hour of the UTC timestamp, Monday 00:00 = 0

a4c_fit.role: MS7 out-of-sample folds (C55): the early borrower model fitted before the first held-out week
